verses: Tuhan Jesus sai hutagam ariari haroroM
Naeng dungo au, naeng rade au, naeng hobas do naposoM.
Pinapulik tu Tuhanku, sirang sian dosa i,
Sai mardalan di na tiur hupaima Rajangki.
Hupaboa na binaen ni Jesus, Sipalua i,
Na humophop ho na dangol, na mamorsan dosa i.
Lao managam haroroNa sai endehononku do
Pangkirimon las ni roha siboanon ni na ro.
Ai tibu do ro Tuhanta, silu do langkana i.
Beta hita lao manomu, taendehon Raja i.
Sai haporseai hataNa, dung i idaonmu do :
Saut sude bagabagaNa, molo dung Tuhanta ro.

r: Pi-na-pu-lik tu Tu-han-ku, si-rang si-an do-sa i, Sai mar-da-lan di na ti-ur hu-pa-i-ma Ra-jang-ki.
Hu-pa-bo-a na bi-naen ni Je-sus, Si-pa-lu-a i, Na hu-mop-hop ho na da-ngol, na ma-mor-san do-sa i.
Lao ma-na-gam ha-ro-ro-Na sai en-de-ho-non-ku do Pang-ki-ri-mon las ni ro-ha si-bo-a-non ni na ro.
Ai ti-bu do ro Tu-han-ta, si-lu do lang-ka-na i. Be-ta hi-ta lao ma-no-mu, ta-en-de-hon Ra-ja i.
Sai ha-por-sea-i ha-ta-Na, dung i i-da-on-mu do: Saut su-de ba-ga-ba-ga-Na, mo-lo dung Tu-han-ta ro.
